verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fly.io publishes an llms.txt at https://fly.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200), headed 'Fly.io Documentation'. That is an agent-oriented docs entry point an AI-native user can point an agent at, which satisfies the story as written. Missing for 10: the markdown docs variant (docs.md returns 404), first-party documentation describing the llms.txt contents or how to use it with agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents consume it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
